name: 707 Headband
description:
This strain emerged from the Humboldt County, California and that area’s telephone area code is the source of its numerical moniker. It’s a cross between Sour Diesel, OG Kush and Master Kush. 707 Headband plants flower in 9 to 11 weeks and usually have large yields. An indica dominant hybrid, this strain is known to have high THC levels and can be strong, but it’s balanced enough to potentially leave most users feeling “heady” and creative rather than sleepy.

description:
FOCUS 1:1 Medical Marijuana Syrup offers versatile usage, allowing it to be administered sublingually (under the tongue) or ingested. For patients seeking a gradual onset, the measured dose may also be mixed into a beverage of choice to support extended-release. Prior to pouring, it's essential to thoroughly shake the bottle to ensure uniform and consistent product distribution.

name: French Connect
description:
Roll back into history with hijinks Temple Ball. Renowned for their nostalgia and quality, Temple Balls are rooted in tradition and artisanal mastery aka "hashtery". Meticulously handcrafted using primo genetics and solventless extraction, this technique and approach has been practiced for centuries.

Ice, water, and fresh-frozen flower are mixed and agitated to separate the
trichomes, capturing a full profile of terpenes and cannabinoids. The resulting hash and water mixture is then freeze dried and allowed to cure, you know this product as bubble hash. The bubble hash is then gently warmed and worked by hand, opening up trichomes and releasing their potential. When the material becomes shiny, glossy, and soft to the touch, we carefully roll the hash into a 1g sized ball. Each Temple Ball boasts a deep and complex flavor profile, showcasing the raw potential of the plant. Indulge in the timeless art of hashish production with Hijinks Temple Balls, where tradition meets modern genetics.

name: Baker's Dozen Kush
full_name: Baker's Dozen Kush | hijinks - Temple Ball
description:
Roll back into history with hijinks Temple Ball. Renowned for their nostalgia and quality, Temple Balls are rooted in tradition and artisanal mastery aka "hashtery". Meticulously handcrafted using primo genetics and solventless extraction, this technique and approach has been practiced for centuries.

Ice, water, and fresh-frozen flower are mixed and agitated to separate the
trichomes, capturing a full profile of terpenes and cannabinoids. The resulting hash and water mixture is then freeze dried and allowed to cure, you know this product as bubble hash. The bubble hash is then gently warmed and worked by hand, opening up trichomes and releasing their potential. When the material becomes shiny, glossy, and soft to the touch, we carefully roll the hash into a 1g sized ball. Each Temple Ball boasts a deep and complex flavor profile, showcasing the raw potential of the plant. Indulge in the timeless art of hashish production with Hijinks Temple Balls, where tradition meets modern genetics.

name: Fresh n' Sweet
full_name: Fresh n' Sweet | hijinks - Temple Ball
description:
Roll back into history with hijinks Temple Ball. Renowned for their nostalgia and quality, Temple Balls are rooted in tradition and artisanal mastery aka "hashtery". Meticulously handcrafted using primo genetics and solventless extraction, this technique and approach has been practiced for centuries.

Ice, water, and fresh-frozen flower are mixed and agitated to separate the
trichomes, capturing a full profile of terpenes and cannabinoids. The resulting hash and water mixture is then freeze dried and allowed to cure, you know this product as bubble hash. The bubble hash is then gently warmed and worked by hand, opening up trichomes and releasing their potential. When the material becomes shiny, glossy, and soft to the touch, we carefully roll the hash into a 1g sized ball. Each Temple Ball boasts a deep and complex flavor profile, showcasing the raw potential of the plant. Indulge in the timeless art of hashish production with Hijinks Temple Balls, where tradition meets modern genetics.

name: Face Mash
description:
Roll back into history with hijinks Temple Ball. Renowned for their nostalgia and quality, Temple Balls are rooted in tradition and artisanal mastery aka "hashtery". Meticulously handcrafted using primo genetics and solventless extraction, this technique and approach has been practiced for centuries.

Ice, water, and fresh-frozen flower are mixed and agitated to separate the
trichomes, capturing a full profile of terpenes and cannabinoids. The resulting hash and water mixture is then freeze dried and allowed to cure, you know this product as bubble hash. The bubble hash is then gently warmed and worked by hand, opening up trichomes and releasing their potential. When the material becomes shiny, glossy, and soft to the touch, we carefully roll the hash into a 1g sized ball. Each Temple Ball boasts a deep and complex flavor profile, showcasing the raw potential of the plant. Indulge in the timeless art of hashish production with Hijinks Temple Balls, where tradition meets modern genetics.
